title: 日本ダービーの後に・燻る

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder finishes the Japanese Derby admirably.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Frustrated with how the race played out, El Condor Pasa challenges her to a rematch at the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But this would warrant a change in our agenda. While Grass Wonder ponders the idea, we're approached by Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She taunts Grass Wonder by saying El Condor Pasa may be more deserving of the moniker "Beast's Successor," then leaves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not one to take that lying down, Grass Wonder decides to accept El Condor Pasa's challenge.
